satellites.title: The Shadow is Questioned
satellites.evidence: In the 齊物論, the penumbra questions the shadow (景). The textual scene asks what determines movement; it should not be mistaken for an optical theory.

cites.locator: ch. 2 齊物論, 罔兩問景

satellites.title: The Shadow Does Not Move
satellites.evidence: 影 was written 景 in early texts; the 彡 was added later. The Mohist Canon uses 景 for shadow in its optics: 景不徙，說在改為 — “the shadow does not move; the explanation lies in its being remade”, moment by moment.
satellites.caveat: The relation 景 → 影 is the traditional account; check historical forms. The translation follows the usual reading, Baracus’s from general knowledge.
